title: 第03章 气血蛊第04章 加入十二洞
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
寻常女人的力气本来就小。
别说单打独斗，甚至多个打一个都不是男人对手。
先除掉威胁最大的，思路很清晰。
李元双目微眯，看来少女早就想好了，先找机会杀掉瘦子，再诱杀老头，最后才发起联合。
“小姑娘，你很聪明嘛。”
胖子道：“可惜你们几个弱女子，联手也打不过小爷。”
“试试才知道！”
少女冷道：“总比我们自相残杀，再被你们臭男人蚕食殆尽要好！”
“这样吧，小爷给你们一个机会。”
胖子阴笑，“你们先去杀了那小子，小爷我保证不帮忙，如何？”
“不如何。”
少女摇头，旋即看向李元，“小哥，要不你先过来，和我们一起杀了这胖子怎么样？”
这是一场心理博弈。
谁都想当渔翁。
“好啊。”
李元一口答应下来。
胖子和少女皆是一愣，都没想到李元如此干脆。
“你疯了？”
胖子再也无法淡定，“你以为我死了这群女人会放过你？！”
“我觉得你这个死胖子比她们威胁大。”

李元咧嘴一笑，迈步走了过去，来到老人的尸体边。
“你先上。”
少女看着李元，故技重施。
“可以。”
李元点头，“不过你们都退开一点，让我先吃口肉补补力气可好？”
少女皱眉。
“行。”
想了想，她还是答应了。
如今主动权在她手中，只要眼前的少年不和胖子联手，就是对她有利的。
她率先退开三步。
另外五个女人相视一眼，也都退开了。
李元这才蹲下身，精准抓住了老头尸体上的那只血虫。
胖子脸都黑了，这愣头青傻小子，不会真的信了那群蛇蝎女人的话，要先杀他吧？
【首次检测到可融合蛊虫，是否合成？】
content_en:
Ordinary women have little strength.
Not to mention fighting alone, even in multiple fights, they are no match for men.
Get rid of the biggest threat first, the idea is very clear.
Li Yuan narrowed his eyes slightly. It seemed that the girl had already thought about it. She would first find an opportunity to kill the thin man, then trap and kill the old man, and finally launch a coalition.
"Little girl, you are very smart."
The fat man said: "It's a pity that you two weak women can't defeat me even if you work together."
“You’ll know after you try it!”
The girl said coldly: "It's better than us killing each other and being cannibalized by you stinky men!"
"Well, I'll give you a chance."
The fat man smiled sinisterly, "You go and kill that kid first. I promise not to help, how about that?"
"Not really."
The girl shook her head and immediately looked at Li Yuan, "Brother, how about you come here first and kill this fat man with us?"
This is a psychological game.
Everyone wants to be a fisherman.
"Okay."
Li Yuan agreed immediately.
Both the fat man and the girl were stunned. They didn't expect Li Yuan to be so straightforward.
"Are you crazy?"
The fat man could no longer remain calm, "Do you think these women will let you go if I die?!"
"I think you, the damn fat guy, are more of a threat than them."
Li Yuan grinned and walked over to the old man's body.
"You go first."
The girl looked at Li Yuan and repeated her old trick.
"Okay."
Li Yuan nodded, "But please step back a little and let me eat meat first to replenish my strength, okay?"
The girl frowned.
"Okay."
After thinking about it, she agreed.
Now the initiative is in her hands. As long as the young man in front of her doesn't join forces with the fat man, it will be in her favor.
She took the first three steps back.
The other five women looked at each other and backed away.
Li Yuan then squatted down and accurately grasped the blood worm on the old man's body.
The fat man's face turned dark. This silly green boy couldn't really believe what those femme fatales said and wanted to kill him first, right?
[For the first time, a fusible Gu insect was detected. Is it synthesized? 】
